expires_today.title: Complete Design Studio
expires_today.long_description:
Turn your imagination and inspiration into a thoughtful blueprint for your home’s future this summer with the ultimate home design bundle from Richdale Ventures! Unlock professional-grade personal CAD software that helps you reimagine every inch of your property, from the bathroom to the backyard. Save big on ArchiMaster 3D, the hottest home-design platform, before this amazing deal disappears, and help support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31st, 2026.

expires_today.title: The EC Comics Artists Library by Fantagraphics
expires_today.description: Celebrate the art of these fantastic comics
expires_today.long_description: Comics need great writers, sure, but they’d be nothing without the talented artists who put their blood, sweat, and tears into bringing these stories to life on the page. Our latest bundle in partnership with Fantagraphics celebrates the iconic artists behind EC Comics’ greatest hits! See the world of Ray Bradbury’s short stories like never before in Home to Stay! The Complete Ray Bradbury EC Stories illustrated by the likes of Reed Crandall, Frank Frazetta, Al Williamson, Wallace Wood, and more! Dive into the work of your favorite artists in collections like Jack Kamen’s Kamen’s Kalamity, Harvey Kurtzman’s Man and Superman, Jack Davis’ ’Taint the Meat… It’s The Humanity!, and Reed Crandall’s The High Cost of Dying. Get 40 collections highlighting EC Comics’ greatest artists for the price of your choice, and support Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Excel Automation 2026 Mastery Bundle
expires_today.description: Start optimizing your data with Excel
expires_today.long_description:
Do you feel a little behind when it comes to using Microsoft Excel? Level up your practical skill sets with the Excel Automation 2026 Mastery Bundle by Zenva. Remove workflow friction and supercharge your productivity with software courses like Intro to Excel Data Tools and Data Management, Excel Tables for Beginners, and Visualize Data with Excel Charts. Additionally, this bundle contains relevant AWS and Claude coding courses! Pay what you want for expert-led Excel courses and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before August 21, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Master Forge MAX-Savings STL Pack 2026

expires_tomorrow.title: React in Production Mega Bundle 2026 by Packt
expires_tomorrow.description: Design, build, and deploy production-ready React applications
expires_tomorrow.long_description: React remains the most widely used web framework, powering more production applications and appearing in more job listings than any other framework. As AI-assisted development becomes the norm, knowing React well matters more, not less. This bundle brings together 17 books written by expert React practitioners and developers who build with it every day. Learn the design patterns and best practices behind React 19, get comfortable with hooks and state management, and understand the architecture decisions that separate a working demo from something that scales. Go further with TypeScript across the stack, full-stack development with popular frameworks and React Native for mobile. Whether you're learning React for the first time, prepping for your next interview, or leveling up how you build in production, this bundle gives you the depth to back it up. A portion of every purchase supports Breast Cancer Research Foundation. Build your complete React library before the deal ends!

expires_tomorrow.title: Built Differently: Builder Games
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Grab your hardhat and shovel because it’s time to clock in at the Built Differently: Builder Games Bundle! Save big on the Game of the Year Edition of Frostpunk, the society-first survival builder where you roleplay as ruler of the last city on Earth. Will you rule with an iron fist? Or build your empire on a foundation of lies? The choices are yours. Or unearth great games like Diplomacy Is Not an Option and Drill Core from this 10-title collection. Plus, your hard work helps support the Her Future Coalition!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 4th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Awesome Indie Adventures
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Looking for your next big adventure? Our newest bundle has our favorite indie games full of dynamic characters and exciting storylines for everyone ready to dive into a great story. Wield your bow and lift the curse on a mysterious island in The Pathless! Solve the puzzles to escape the Gloom in the retro survival horror game Post Trauma! Become the monsters you kill and rebuild a fallen civilization in Biomorph! There’s even more adventure to discover in this bundle, so grab these great games now at the price of your choosing and support music charity Reverb with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.

Speed through your next development process with elite environmental assets and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!
